name: California Girls State (American Legion Auxiliary)
org: American Legion Auxiliary, Department of California
city: California (session location not stated on the site)
what_you_do: You attend a one-week summer leadership session. It is for 11th grade girls. The American Legion Auxiliary runs it. A local Auxiliary Unit chooses and sponsors each delegate. The pages do not describe the daily activities.
grades: 11th grade (the site says each delegate is an 11th grader during the 2025-26 school year)
who_can_apply: Girls in 11th grade who are selected and sponsored by a local American Legion Auxiliary Unit. Each high school may have only one delegate. If a school has no sponsoring Unit, a student can apply as a Department (statewide) alternate applicant. Age rules are not stated.
pay_detail: Cost not stated on the pages read. The site says there are opportunities for scholarship consideration, including the Samsung American Legion Scholarship.
duration: One week. The 2026 session (83rd) ran June 22-27, 2026.
deadline_text: 2026 session: June 22-27, 2026. 2027 dates and application deadlines are not posted on the site.
how_to_apply: Ask your school counselor or contact a local American Legion Auxiliary Unit (the site has a spreadsheet to find one). Each Unit picks a delegate and two alternates. Students at schools with no sponsoring Unit can use the START HERE online application as Department alternate applicants.
notes: Separate from the coed American Legion California Boys State (Boys & Girls State) program, which has its own card on this site. The FAQ says a student may apply to either American Legion CA Boys State or American Legion Auxiliary CA Girls State, but not both. Selection criteria, grade-school rules beyond the 11th grade note, and cost are not stated on the pages read.
